method: Every 30th frame was rendered with every ball candidate from an ensemble (YOLO11x COCO at 1280, the same tiled, and the football-finetuned model tiled, all at conf>=0.04) circled and numbered, plus a zoomed crop of each. A human picked which candidate, if any, is the match ball; frames where no candidate was the ball were re-checked at 2.2x zoom over the whole pitch before being called absent.

notes.120: Camera at its widest; ball not visible anywhere on the pitch at 2.2x zoom.
notes.420: Ball not visible anywhere on the pitch at 2.2x zoom.
notes.recurring_fp_left_edge: Frames 150-330 carry a persistent whitish smear near the left touchline that the football-finetuned model scores 0.15-0.8. It is not the match ball and is counted as a false positive.
notes.recurring_fp_crowd: Frames 480-720: a yellow-green object in the stand that the COCO model scores 0.1-0.25 as a sports ball.
